verdicts.reason: Both drop the hands photo, so the design is no longer recognisable. A keeps the quote readable at a sensible size, but 'MAHATMA GANDHI' is pulled far to the right, away from its quote, a black bar fragment is clipped at the top edge, and faint plus marks sit against the right edge. B is worse: the quote is tiny, the attribution is set bolder than the quote (inverted hierarchy), stray outlined cloud and plus shapes clutter the left side, and an orphaned black bar sits at the bottom.
